title: 3701 NORTH GLENRIDGE DRIVE; BOARD FILE NO. 260041
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
3701 NORTH GLENRIDGE DRIVE; BOARD FILE NO. 260041
  C.D.: 4 (Councilmember Nithya Raman); Sherman Oaks – Studio City – Toluca Lake – Cahuenga
  Pass Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Alan Morelos
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  Arthur Boghossian

  Consideration of Application to export 3,990.63 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration whether the project is categorically exempt under CEQA pursuant to Section 15303
  (Class 3) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines (Case No. ENV-2026-
  2852-CE), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
